title: Embedding an Ethical Mind: Aligning Text-to-Image Synthesis via Lightweight Value Optimization

bias_targets.methodology: Generating images from text prompts containing specific concepts (e.g., careers, positive/negative words) and using a zero-shot CLIP classifier to determine the gender (male/female) of the generated figures, evaluated by calculating Discrepancy Scores (D1 and D2) to measure the deviation from an ideal uniform distribution.

Generating images from text prompts containing specific concepts and using a zero-shot CLIP classifier to classify the race of the generated figures into five categories (White, Black, Asian, Indian, Latino), evaluated by calculating Discrepancy Scores (D1 and D2) to measure the deviation from an ideal uniform distribution.
